about: A Cell's character as data, so the column, the phone and the watch draw the same body. `body` is the silhouette, one string per row of pixels from the top, `#` filled. The eyes are cut out of it: each sits in a box of `eyes.size` (columns, rows) whose top-left pixel is `eyes.left` or `eyes.right`. Each mood draws its eyes as rows of that box; a mood without `right` mirrors `left`. The body wears its provider's hue, or the interface ink when the provider has none; the eyes show what lies under the character. A mood a screen does not know draws as `fallback`.
